Detailed Description

template<class OwnerType = void>
class TSpawnEventBase< OwnerType >

An event class for use with a TSpawn UGen.

You can use an OwnerType to reference another object when the UGen is constructed. Use TSpawnEventBase<void> or TSpawnEventBase<> if there's no owner.

See also:
TSpawn , TSpawnEventBase<void>
